parent_objective: audit sparse M1412 warmup-history outcome positives before retargeting or training
blocked_by: M1412 has sparse warmup-history positives with only 3 accepted-history seeds and weak wrong-warmup signal
supersedes: exporting M1412 as a corpus without source-diverse near-boundary repeats

public_gates: M1413 must audit M1412 sparse positives before any training or corpus export
M1413 must distinguish clear-stratum positives from collision-heavy positives
M1413 must decide retune, retarget, repeat, stop, or synthesize
M1413 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not claim level3 self-identification from M1412 sparse positives
do not ignore weak wrong-warmup signal

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits sparse M1412 outcome positives and decides whether to retarget clear near-boundary source rows before another outcome probe
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if sparse positives are treated as sufficient evidence
stop if audit routes to training or corpus export
stop if weak wrong-warmup signal is ignored
stop if actor input changes are proposed
fallback_plan: retune gate/source selection toward clear near-boundary rows if M1412 is promising but seed-thin
route to branch synthesis if retargeting would be another narrow loop
stop branch if M1412 does not justify a retargeted repeat

admission_evidence: M1412 finds 14 warmup-history-positive rows but only 3 accepted-history seeds
M1412 positives are not collision-only but are still sparse
M1412 wrong-warmup variants produce zero positives
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one follow-up manifest if the audit admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1413 must keep M1412 below level3 because positives are sparse and wrong-warmup variants remain negative.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Sparse positives and wrong-warmup negatives must be recorded as constraints before retargeting.
allowed_claims: M1412 result audit and next-route decision
no outcome intervention, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1412 sparse positive result can be audited into a safer retargeting decision without overclaiming self-identification or entering training.
success_criteria: audit records M1412 accepted-history diversity and collision strata
audit records weak or negative wrong-warmup evidence
audit chooses retune, retarget, repeat, stop, or synthesis without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: audit treats M1412 as public-positive self-ID evidence
audit routes directly to training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1413 passes if it classifies M1412 sparse positives into an explicit non-training next route.
